title: Floating embedded game window with captured mouse moves off-screen when dragged
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.1-stable and 4.6-rc1

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

When the game runs embedded in a floating game window, if you alt-tab out to release focus from the game and then grab the game window's title bar to move it, the window moves by itself down to the very bottom of the screen.

It's not reproducible when running the game unembedded -- in that case the window simply won't move at all, which I'm not sure whether it's a bug or not.

Can be worked around with some logic like this:
```gdscript
func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT:
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE
	elif what == NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_IN:
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
```

Video:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/244b33d2-a290-4a3a-81ee-18ddaf9ffa0e

### Steps to reproduce

- Enable _Embed Game on Next Play_ and _Make Game Workspace Floating on Next Play_
- Run `Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED` on startup
- Run game and alt-tab out
- Grab the game window's title bar and then try to move the window

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mouse_captured_window_move_bug_2026-01-19_22-12-47.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24723753/mouse_captured_window_move_bug_2026-01-19_22-12-47.zip)
